sentences.text: Rupelramphastoides was an extinct bird related to woodpeckers found in the Lower Oligocene of Germany.
Scientists have recorded only a single fossil occurrence of this unique bird in the entire scientific database.
The genus Rupelramphastoides was formally named by Mayr in 2005.
The only known species within this group is Rupelramphastoides knopfi.
The genus is currently classified as family incertae sedis because additional specimens have not yet been found.
Rupelramphastoides lived during the Rupelian stage, between 33.9 and 27.3 million years ago.
